Technical & price structure: In plain terms: Telecom Egypt is the country’s fixed-line and fibre incumbent, the operator of the Suez subsea-cable corridor, the fourth mobile network (WE) — and the owner of 45% of Vodafone Egypt, whose profit contribution grew 71% last year. Marked part by part the pieces are worth ~EGP 139 a share before any discount; at 92.61 the market pays a ~33% discount to that sum. The whole argument is whether an excellent 2025 — revenue +31%, margin 45%, leverage down to 1.3× — plus approved 13–15% tariff rises finally shrink the wrapper discount toward the 15% we think is fair.
Monte Carlo — where could the price go?: 50,000 paths, 16 forces: the EGX secular drift this name is calibrated to, the CBE easing cycle, the EGP (USD-linked wholesale revenue against FX losses), the NTRA tariff round, data demand, Vodafone Egypt momentum, capex intensity, the government-placement overhang, Red Sea subsea risk and index flows. Details in the methodology .
FAQ: What is the fair-value range for Telecom Egypt (ETEL)? — testahil publishes a probability distribution of where ETEL could trade over the next 1–3 months — the simulated 5th–95th percentile range and the central 50% — not a single price target or a buy/sell call. The full study and open model show the methodology. This is educational analysis, not investment advice.

How is the ETEL valuation calculated? — The study uses an instrument-appropriate lens — a sum-of-the-parts — the core telecom marked on EV/EBITDA and the 45% Vodafone Egypt stake marked on earnings — combined with a 50,000-path Monte Carlo simulation that expresses the result as a probability distribution. Every assumption is visible and editable in the free Excel model.

Does testahil recommend buying or selling ETEL? — No. testahil never issues buy, sell, or hold recommendations. It publishes fair-value ranges and probability distributions as educational material, and grades its own forecasts publicly when they resolve.
Is the Telecom Egypt model free to download? — Yes. The full ETEL valuation study (Word/PDF) and the open Excel model are free to download, with every assumption editable.
